scheme_name: Educational Assistance to the 10th to 12th Students
other_conditions: The child’s parents or guardians must be registered under the Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
Only children and the spouse of registered construction workers are eligible.
The child must have passed the 10th or 12th standard with at least 50% marks.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 for children scoring at least 50% in 10th or 12th standard exams.
